This is the complete public core-library, mux/demux, SIMD, and upstream CMake
source closure: 203 files totaling 2940103 bytes. Tools, examples, tests,
documentation, language bindings, unrelated build systems, and test media are
not stored.

Every selected upstream file and its SHA-256 is recorded in the case-insensitive
path-sorted SOURCE_MANIFEST.sha256. The 17959-byte manifest has SHA-256:
17e0a0e557d3b80e464da8ad5832836d992a7882ec365ff58b33d1fda16f4ba8

SceneIO configures the unmodified upstream CMake project from this directory
with shared libraries, command-line tools, animation utilities, examples,
extras, JavaScript, fuzz targets, and libwebpmux disabled. SIMD remains enabled.
The upstream directory is added EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL so only targets required by
SceneIO's private static webp link are built and no libwebp development files
are installed into the wheel.

There are no local source changes.
